description.value: You have spent substantial time around the other peoples of the Szandite Collective, and you know their cultures as well as that of atraxids. Select binnaquid, fonqugon, hardor, mecanaic, ord, or phasorq. You can select ancestry feats from the chosen ancestry, in addition to your character's own ancestries, as long as the ancestry feats don't require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM. When you select this feat, you additionally gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from your chosen ancestry.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
